decisions.reason: The final sentence universally excludes global equilibrium whenever any of T, rho or u is nonconstant. In a bounded box in uniform Newtonian gravity, the adopted canonical equilibrium density on position and momentum is proportional to exp[-beta(|p|^2/(2M)+Mgh)], beta=1/(k_B T)>0. Integrating over momentum leaves rho(h) proportional to exp[-beta Mgh], which is nonconstant for M,g>0, while T is constant and the mean velocity vanishes by oddness. This is a conditional equilibrium model, not an observation. The repair preserves all local fields and comparison-cell criteria and replaces the false exclusion with the need for an explicit whole-system equilibrium criterion.
